config_entries.label: Name
config_entries.description: The name of the effect. Defaults to `Strobe`.

config_entries.label: Colors
config_entries.description: A list of colors to cycle through. Defaults to a quick cycle between ON and OFF.

config_entries.label: Duration
config_entries.description: The duration this color should be active.

config_entries.label: Blue
config_entries.description: The blue channel of the light, if applicable. Defaults to `100%`.

config_entries.label: Brightness
config_entries.description: The brightness of the light. Defaults to `100%`.

config_entries.label: Cold White
config_entries.description: The cold white channel of the light, if applicable. Defaults to `100%`.

config_entries.label: Color
config_entries.description: A [standard CSS color name](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/named-color) or a hex value in the form `0xRRGGBB` to use instead of **red**, **green** and **blue**. Also sets **color_brightness**, as described in [light state](https://esphome.io/components/light/#light-state).

config_entries.label: Color Brightness
config_entries.description: The brightness of the RGB lights, if applicable. Defaults to `100%`.

config_entries.label: Color Mode
config_entries.description: The color mode of the light. Defaults to the current color mode.

config_entries.label: Color Temperature
config_entries.description: The color temperature (in [mireds](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mired) or Kelvin) of the light, if applicable.

config_entries.label: Green
config_entries.description: The green channel of the light, if applicable. Defaults to `100%`.

config_entries.label: Red
config_entries.description: The red channel of the light, if applicable. Defaults to `100%`.

config_entries.label: State
config_entries.description: The ON/OFF state to show. Defaults to `ON`.

config_entries.label: Transition Length
config_entries.description: The duration of each transition. Defaults to `0s`.

config_entries.label: Warm White
config_entries.description: The warm white channel of the light, if applicable. Defaults to `100%`.

config_entries.label: White
config_entries.description: The white channel of the light, if applicable. Defaults to `100%`.
